## Claim correspondence and editorial choices

Tourism authority pages support central Teide volcanic highlands, La Laguna historic streets, northeastern Anaga laurel forest and Puerto de la Cruz harbour. The one-day driving article supports only La Laguna’s description; its cross-island sequence is explicitly rejected. SQ park/harbour labels are translated. Two airports are described as arrival options on one island, with base-dependent journeys. Teide wording directs readers to current access, reservation and closure rules without summit/cable-car promises.

Retained Teide, La Laguna, Anaga, Puerto harbour order and a northern Puerto base. Choices are separate outings, not a same-day itinerary.
